mismatches.say: Your exam, P S I Series sixteen eighty-one, has one hundred fifty scored items.
mismatches.heard: Your exam, PSI Series 1681, has 150 scored items.

mismatches.say: The four smallest, Businessowners, Workers' Comp, Other Coverages and Dwelling, add up to twenty-seven items. Don't skip them.
mismatches.heard: The four smallest, business owners, workers comp, other coverages and dwelling, add up to 27 items. Do not skip them.

mismatches.say: Watch for except and not. In an except item, three choices fit the stem. Pick the one that doesn't.
mismatches.heard: Watch for accept and not. In an accept item, three choices fit the stem. Pick the one that does not.

mismatches.say: Your turn. Which of these IDs will get you into the exam? Pick an answer.
mismatches.heard: Your turn, which of these ID will get you into the exam? Pick an answer.

mismatches.say: Now, your path to a license. Finish prelicensing education first, or your exam results are invalidated: forty hours for combined property and casualty.
mismatches.heard: Now, your path to a license. Finish pre-licensing education first or your exam results are invalidated. 40 hours for combined property and casualty.

mismatches.say: One hundred eighty days. After that, you need a new application and fee. Twelve months is your course certificate, not your application.
mismatches.heard: After that, you need a new application and fee. Twelve months is your course certificate, not your application.

mismatches.say: Last, this app. Each day, do Start today's session first. Misses come back next session, and right answers after growing gaps. Then add new material, roughly by weight.
mismatches.heard: Last this app, each day do start today's session first. Misses come back next session and write answers after growing gaps. Then add new material roughly by weight.
